name: Tane o Tsukeru Otoko ~Mezase Zen'in Jutai~
original_name: 種をつける男〜めざせ全員受胎〜
source: After being tested for cancer, the protagonist is faced with his own mortality.  Realizing there is no way to extend his own life, he is determined to pass on his genes to a new generation.  The protagonist then sets out to impregnate as many women as he can.
translation: 接受癌症检查后，主人公不得不直面自己的死亡。意识到没有办法延长生命，他决心把自己的基因传给下一代。于是，主人公开始设法让尽可能多的女性怀孕。
